::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 9th 1900  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Reading University Library 1448/119
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_279.qmd)
It was like old times to see your writing again.  I have no doubt that it is right about [Forget me nots](cmy_books/cmybook_330.qmd)but I see so many stories advertised even before they are really finished in their serials that I thought it was time to see about the matter.  In fact it is a ‘goody story’ only about school mistresses and quite short.  I think it might in time be published together with some of the [Innes](people/person_744.qmd)’ books, which have had a large sale once, and are now and then asked for

My books have certainly kept up much better than I ever dared to expect, but I doubt whether I shall ever manage another long story, and I ought to be satisfied with 50 years of work and success.

I have been asked several times for a cheap edition of [Bp Patteson](cmy_books/cmybook_102.qmd), but I see there are 200 still in stock, so I suppose it is of no use to think about it.

I am perfectly well, thank you but slower in all things than I used to be

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
